purpose: Outcome-blind, zero-cost, full 179-leaf supplemental Ox Alpha scoring successor. GPT-5.6 remains primary.

selection.selection_rule: The inherited outcome-blind public-HANNA order is frozen before any v8 Ox outcome exists.

questions.primary_rule: Use all 178 static leaves plus the compiled HANNA task-contract leaf. Missing, duplicate, positional, or prefix substitutions are errors.
questions.secondary_ablation: Score both systems after removing only the dynamic leaf and its task-contract weighted goal. This is a noncanonical two-leaf Relevance ablation with core.task_and_brief_fidelity.operation.

runtime.serial_rationale: The bridge mutex serializes individual HTTP attempts but does not prove cell-level quiescence or preserve the required completed-cell verification boundary under three shards. This successor therefore stays serial.

remote_disclosure.destination: Nous hardened tool-free judge bridge -> authenticated Nous service
remote_disclosure.sent: Only the three selected public HANNA stories, paired public prompts, task contracts, HBQ questions, and judge instructions.
remote_disclosure.not_sent: No private prose, private repository content, credentials, raw local evidence, unrelated files, or new human data.

zero_cost.catalog_binding: No-purchase public-HANNA pilot. Stop before any paid route, new human work, or provider upgrade.

interpretation_limits: Missing provider max attestation is an expected provisional blocker, not a launch stop.
All Ox Alpha evidence is provisional even if transport evidence is otherwise valid.
No exact-gate, promotion, model replacement, or human-alignment claim follows from this pilot.
